replay.title: The Liar's Table — the Silver Chalice at Wyvern Manor

frames.label: Q1 · CHECK DOOR LOG
frames.outcome: Trophy Room door keypad log: 8:10 pm locked after the tour · 8:44 pm opened · 8:47 pm closed · 10:02 pm opened by Dame Cressida (theft discovered). No other entries.

frames.label: Q2 · CHECK CCTV
frames.outcome: CCTV stills (each slot shows everyone in the room): Billiard Room camera — 8:30: Rosalind, Harriet and Odette · 9:00: empty · 9:30: empty. Music Room camera — 8:30: NO FOOTAGE (camera offline 8:22–8:56) · 9:00: Harriet · 9:30: empty. No other rooms have cameras.

frames.label: Q3 · CHECK WITNESS
frames.outcome: Statement of the footman, Tobias, who served drinks in the Library from 8:30 to 10:00 without leaving it. Guests present: 8:30 — nobody; 9:00 — Odette; 9:30 — Silas.

frames.label: Q4 · ASK Silas ABOUT 8:30
frames.outcome: Silas: "At 8:30 I was in the Library. Nobody else was there."

frames.label: Verdict
frames.action: ACCUSE Silas BECAUSE at 8:30 Silas claimed the Library, but the witness says otherwise
frames.outcome: Correct! Silas was in the Trophy Room at 8:30, not in the Library.
